classification_model_2_results: Holds predicted and actual return-visit purchase outcomes at the session level (one row per unique_session_id) with keys/IDs: unique_session_id and columns: predicted_will_buy_on_return_visit, predicted_will_buy_on_return_visit_probs, will_buy_on_return_visit, latest_ecommerce_progress, bounces, time_on_site, pageviews, source, medium, channelGrouping, deviceCategory, country.
site_wide_promotion: Holds site-level promotion data (one row per record of promotion) with column: discount.
partitions: Holds partition-level aggregate counts (one row per PARTITION/date) with columns: total_transactions, date_formatted, PARTITION.
rev_transactions: Holds hit- and transaction-level ecommerce records (one row per hit/transaction event) with keys/IDs: fullVisitorId, visitId, date, hits_time and notable measures/fields: channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country, geoNetwork_city, totals_totalTransactionRevenue, totals_transactions, totals_timeOnSite, totals_pageviews, hits_type, hits_product_productRefundAmount, hits_product_productQuantity, hits_product_productPrice, hits_product_productRevenue, hits_product_productSKU, hits_product_v2ProductName, hits_product_v2ProductCategory, hits_product_productVariant, hits_item_currencyCode, hits_item_itemQuantity, hits_item_itemRevenue, hits_transaction_transactionRevenue, hits_transaction_transactionId, hits_page_pageTitle, hits_page_searchKeyword, hits_page_pagePathLevel1.
products: Holds product master/inventory rows (one row per SKU) with key: SKU and columns: name, orderedQuantity, stockLevel, restockingLeadTime, sentimentScore, sentimentMagnitude.
product_list: Holds product SKU-to-name mapping (one row per productSKU) with columns: productSKU, v2ProductName.
days_with_rain: Holds daily precipitation readings by station (one row per date + station_name) with columns: date, station_name, prcp, PARTITION.
checkout_nudge: Holds per-user aggregated browsing/checkout signals (one row per fullVisitorID) with key: fullVisitorID and columns: number_of_sessions, number_of_products_viewed, session_time_on_site_minutes_max, eCommerceAction_type_max.
all_sessions: Holds session-level web analytics and ecommerce data (one row per visitId/session) with keys/IDs: fullVisitorId, visitId, date and columns: channelGrouping, time, country, city, totalTransactionRevenue, transactions, timeOnSite, pageviews, sessionQualityDim, type, productRefundAmount, productQuantity, productPrice, productRevenue, productSKU, v2ProductName, v2ProductCategory, productVariant, currencyCode, itemQuantity, itemRevenue, transactionRevenue, transactionId, pageTitle, searchKeyword, pagePathLevel1, eCommerceAction_type, eCommerceAction_step, eCommerceAction_option.
sales_report: Holds aggregated sales metrics per SKU (one row per productSKU) with key: productSKU and columns: total_ordered, name, stockLevel, restockingLeadTime, sentimentScore, sentimentMagnitude, ratio.
sales_by_sku: Holds SKU-level sales totals (one row per productSKU) with columns: productSKU, total_ordered.
web_analytics: Holds raw visitor/visit analytics (one row per visitId/visitStartTime) with keys/IDs: visitorId, fullVisitorId, visitId, visitStartTime, date and nested fields: totals, trafficSource, device, geoNetwork, customDimensions, hits, plus top-level: visitNumber, userId, channelGrouping, socialEngagementType.
categories: Holds product-to-category mappings; grain = one row per productSKU-category pair; keys/measures = productSKU, category.
all_sessions_raw: Holds raw web analytics and e-commerce event data at the session/product-action level; grain = one row per observed session-product or session-action record (one row per combination of fullVisitorId, visitId/time and product/eCommerce action); keys/measures = fullVisitorId, visitId, date, time, channelGrouping, country, city, sessionQualityDim, pageviews, timeOnSite, totalTransactionRevenue, transactions, transactionId, transactionRevenue, productSKU, v2ProductName, v2ProductCategory, productVariant, productPrice, productQuantity, productRevenue, productRefundAmount, itemQuantity, itemRevenue, currencyCode, pageTitle, pagePathLevel1, searchKeyword, eCommerceAction_type, eCommerceAction_step, eCommerceAction_option, type.
partition_by_day: Holds partition metadata or simplified visitor/day rows; grain = one row per fullvisitorId per date_formatted partition; keys/measures = date_formatted, fullvisitorId, PARTITION.
